message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a weekday and is surrounded by at least one weekend day, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed on Monday, Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Family Day is a provincial holiday; it’s not observed in all provinces. |
| **Apr 7–10** | Good Friday & Easter Monday | Good Friday is a federal holiday; Easter Monday is a federal holiday in some provinces (e.g., Ontario, Quebec). |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed on Monday, Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is a federal holiday. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday. |
| **Nov 10–11** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day fell on Friday, so the holiday was observed on Friday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas | Christmas fell on Monday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |

### Quick Tips for Your App

1. **Province‑specific holidays** – If you want to show province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day, Easter Monday in certain provinces), you’ll need a data source that includes provincial holiday calendars.  
2. **Observance rules** – Some holidays are “observed” on a different day if they fall on a weekend (e.g., New Year’s Day, Canada Day). Make sure your logic accounts for this.  
3. **Future years** – For 2024 and beyond, you can generate similar tables by applying the same rules (e.g., New Year’s Day observed on Monday if it falls on a weekend, etc.).  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown (including provincial variations) or if you need help integrating this into your holiday‑planning app!
